meta.name: Challenge Accepted
meta.description:
Challenge Accepted follows Michelle Khare as she attempts the world's most difficult lifestyles, stunts, and professions.

Shows: I Tried Marine Bootcamp, I Trained Like a NASA Astronaut, I Tried FBI Academy, I Tried Tom Cruise's Deadliest Stunt, I Tried Solving A Rubik's Cube In Under 60 Seconds
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
